props.name: bars
props.description: How many bars go round the ring. Ignored with `value`, which sets one bar per entry.

props.name: pattern
props.description: The wave to run. Ignored with `wave` or `value`.

props.name: wave
props.description: Your own wave: the length at `angle` (turns from the top, 0 to 1) at `t` seconds, from 0 to 1.

props.name: value
props.description: Controls the lengths directly, one entry per bar going clockwise from the top.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the base ring, as a fraction of the room available; bars grow from here.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between bars, as a fraction of each bar's slot of the ring.

props.name: rounded
props.description: Round the ends of `bars`.

props.name: segments
props.description: Blocks per bar for the `segments` variant.

props.name: lines
props.description: Loops drawn for the `lines` variant; extra loops trail the wave back in time.

props.name: spread
props.description: Seconds between stacked `lines`.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Stroke width of `lines`, in CSS pixels.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: Scales every length; 1 lets bars reach the edge.

props.name: frequency
props.description: Scales how many lobes a built-in pattern fits around the ring.

props.name: speed
props.description: Scales how fast the wave changes.

props.name: spin
props.description: Turns per second the whole ring rotates; negative turns it counterclockwise.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: From 0 (bars jump to each new length) to 1 (bars glide slowly toward it).

props.name: interactive
props.description: Hovering raises a bump in the ring at the pointer's angle.

props.name: color
props.description: Bar color; any CSS color, including `var(--token)`. Defaults to the text color.

props.name: colors
props.description: Gradient stops; any CSS colors. Wins over `palette`.

props.name: palette
props.description: A ready-made gradient.

props.name: gradient
props.description: Which way a gradient runs.

props.name: glow
props.description: A soft halo around the ring, like neon.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible description; defaults to the pattern name.
